item.title: Iran War Updates: Tehran and U.S. Offer Conflicting Messages on State of Negotiations
item.description: President Trump said his administration had had “very good talks” with Tehran in the last 24 hours. An Iranian official said an American plan to end the war was under review. Israel struck targets near Beirut.

item.title: IDF claims to have taken out Hamas commander who participated in Oct 7
item.description: The IDF announced it killed Hamas Nukhba Commander Anas Hamed in a targeted Gaza airstrike, saying he raided Israel during the Oct. 7 Nova massacre.

item.title: Oil prices drop and stock markets rise after reports of deal to end Iran war
item.description: Reports have raised hopes of an agreement between the US and Iran after days of escalation.

item.title: China calls for Strait to be reopened 'as soon as possible' in Iran talks
item.description: Wang Yi is holding talks with Iran's foreign minister Aragchi who is on his first trip to China since the war began.

item.title: Could Iran use ‘kamikaze dolphins’ against the US in the Strait of Hormuz?
item.description: As US-Iran tensions escalate around the Strait of Hormuz, a journalist at a Pentagon briefing this week asked top US officials an out-of-the ordinary question: whether Tehran could deploy “kamikaze dolphins” against US warships. The idea isn’t as far-fetched as it seems, as multiple countries have a history of using marine mammals for military uses.

item.title: China's 'key priorities': Open Hormuz, get oil flowing, avoid 'getting dragged into conflicts'

item.title: Trump keeps changing his timeline for ending the Iran war
